text:
omar: deploy-bot flagged an uptick in 429s and session lose-rate on the staged canary (3%). Change window ~40m. requesting stop/go.

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary traffic 3% -> 429 rate 0.95% (baseline 0.05%), session-drop +1.6% (baseline 0.05%). Event ref: sa-21c. No auto-rollback rule matched. See /deploy 19901 for manifests and diff.

tess: can someone paste the telemetry link?

omar: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/canary/19901 5% of 429s correlate to session-token mismatch after upstream LB sticky routing change in canary hosts.

rajesh: that sticky routing change was supposed to be transparent. If sessions are bouncing between nodes we can see desynced in-memory session caches -> token rejects.

ops-bot: [metric] lb-session-miss rate spike on canary hosts infer-b[20-23].region-us-east-2. Connection churn +12%.

kate: plan: freeze progression and pin to the previous stable (v6.8.2) while we triage. we'll also flip LB stickiness back on the canary pool as a quick mitigation.

omar: running: `rollout pin --deployment session-service-canary --version v6.8.2 --by omar --reason "session token mismatches -> 429s"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout pinned to v6.8.2 by omar at 4512346040. Canary traffic held at 3%.

rajesh: executing LB flip: `infra lb toggle-stickiness --pool session-canary --state on --by rajesh` ETA ~4m. I'll also run a quick script to backfill session cache for affected hosts.

ops-bot: [update] lb-stickiness flip started at 4512346060. backfill job queued.

pm: for release notes and comms: record rollback criteria: 429 rate >0.6% sustained for 10m OR session-drop >0.5% sustained for 10m -> full rollback to v6.8.2 across regions. I'll add that to the release notes.

kate: monitoring: if metrics fall under 0.2% for rolling 20m then unpin and continue conservative ramp to 6% with manual approval.

rajesh: backfill done, stickiness restored. initial smoke shows 429 rate dropped to 0.18%, session-drop back to 0.06%.

deploy-bot: [metric] 429 rate 0.18%, session-drop 0.06%, p95 latency unchanged.

omar: great. vote: unpin and resume OR keep pinned for longer. React with :+1: unpin now, :eyes: monitor another 15m, :-1: rollback.

tess: :+1:

rajesh: :+1:

kate: :eyes: (prefer monitor 15m but ok to unpin if stable)

pm: :+1:

deploy-bot: [action] Votes tallied: majority to unpin after 15m monitor. Monitoring window extended 15m.

omar: will update postmortem draft with timeline, LB config diff, and backfill script. Thanks all.
